domain: all elements including identity of the prime-order subgroup, uniform ordered pairs; identity filter value is fixed0
filters: F2-linear x-functionals Tr(z^(offset+i)*x), offset1 or2, j=1,2,3,4; separately the halving trace alpha1; x-only SHA256 null matched to each effective alphabet size
combiner: XOR over encoded F2^j, offsets chosen after seeing filter
statistic: pi[s,c]=#{(Q,R): h(Q) xor h(R)=s and h(Q+R)=c}/#{(Q,R):h(Q) xor h(R)=s}; G=M_eff*max over nonempty s,c; d=s xor c
non_surjective: Report nominal M, effective image size and both gains; SHA null uses matched effective image size. Trace-constant subgroup filter has M_eff=1 and gain1.
exactness: FFT group convolution plus Walsh-Hadamard alphabet convolution rounded to integer counts only after residual<1e-6; check totals and independent direct pair enumeration on n7
positive_controls: Full cyclic curve group: halving trace parity, and index mod4 quotient with point-based discrete-log table. The latter is an instrument control, not an efficiently computable x-only candidate.
scope: Toy exact level1 counts, no asymptotic bound or growing-gain claim. No security statement, no official open-problem status transition.
resource: one CPU worker; no GPU; unqualified container timings
